Official text: the face (from forehead edge to bottom of chin) should be 70 to 80% of the photo or one inch height; 70-80% of 45 mm is 31.5-36.0 mm. The page measures from the forehead, not the top of the hair, and its 'one inch' alternative (25.4 mm) conflicts with the percentage.
Close up of head and partial shoulders, centred, neutral expression, eyes open.
Prescription glasses only if clear, thin-framed, without reflection and not obscuring the eyes.
